highlights.title: Smaller downloads for future macOS updates
highlights.description: This release introduces Sparkle. The first upgrade from an older version still needs a full package; after installation and restart, subsequent releases can use deltas with full-package fallback.

highlights.title: Less full-document work when opening PDFs
highlights.description: Reading prioritizes text from the current and neighboring pages. Search and assistant actions prepare full text when needed, while the PDF engine runs in a Worker to reduce UI-thread work.

highlights.title: Less repeated work when searching
highlights.description: When refining search terms in the same long document, prepared search text is reused to reduce repeated processing.

highlights.title: Lower memory use in Reading Memory queries
highlights.description: Semantic retrieval limits temporary candidate lists to reduce memory usage when querying larger reading libraries.

highlights.title: Start reading on your first launch
highlights.description: Enter the library without finishing every onboarding page, import your reading material, and configure AI later.
